title: [Master]-Withholding Tax Posting generates Unbalanced G/L Entries when Multiple Withholding Tax Rates are used on one Purchase Invoice.
summary: The withholding tax posting calculation is corrected to prevent unbalanced G/L entries when multiple withholding tax rates apply to a single purchase invoice.
key_points: Fixes unbalanced G/L entries when one purchase invoice uses several withholding tax rates
The change is in the Wthldg Tax Purch. Subscribers codeunit of the WithholdingTax app
Small change of 4 added and 2 removed lines in one file, with no tests included
